title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E22 — Dance With Me, Herman
After seeing the school ball's invitation, Herman takes dancing lessons from a shady dance instructor.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E23 — Follow That Munster
Herman takes a correspondence course to become a private detective.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E24 — Love Locked Out
Herman gets a little tipsy at an office party; Lily makes him spend the night on the sofa after he comes home drunk.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E25 — Come Back, Little Googie
Grandpa tries to turn Eddie's nasty pal (Bill Mumy) into a rabbit.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E26 — Far Out Munsters
A visiting rock 'n' roll group attempts to rent the Munster house for privacy.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E27 — Munsters on the Move
Herman is offered a job promotion that would mean moving out of town.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E28 — Movie Star Munster
Two gangsters try to use Herman to swindle insurance companies.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E29 — Herman the Rookie
Herman is given a tryout by Leo Durocher after his mighty drive sends a baseball sailing out of the ballpark.

title: The Munsters
description:
S1 E30 — Country Club Munsters
Herman is convinced that a television competition is fixed, until he wins free membership at an exclusive country club.

title: The Creature Walks Among Us
description:
S1
Scientists (Jeff Morrow, Rex Reason) capture the creature from the black lagoon and turn him into an air breather.

title: Curse of the Undead
description:
S1
A cow-town preacher (Eric Fleming) shoots a custom bullet at a vampire gunfighter (Michael Pate) in the Old West.

title: The Curse of the Werewolf
description:
S1
The son of a servant assaulted by a beggar becomes a wolfman in 18th-century Spain.

title: Curucu, Beast of the Amazon
description:
S1
A doctor (Beverly Garland) and an adventurer (John Bromfield) head for the Amazon, where a guy (Tom Payne) in a bird suit is scaring natives.

title: The Deadly Mantis
description:
S1
A U.S. colonel (Craig Stevens) and a paleontologist (William Hopper) track a huge praying mantis from the North Pole to Manhattan.

title: Dr. Cyclops
description:
S1
A mad doctor (Albert Dekker) in Peru reduces a woman (Janice Logan) and three men to one-fifth their normal size.

title: Dracula
description:
S1
This was made at night using the same sets and script as the Bela Lugosi classic but with a Spanish cast.

title: Dracula
description:
S1
Van Helsing (Laurence Olivier) investigates as the vampire count (Frank Langella) scales walls and visits bedrooms at an English manor.
